column1: # Classification of the repository's macros (docs/swift-migration/hidden-callers.md section 6).
# One row per macro that the migration's scope defines or expands and that is of a kind in that section's
# table. codedb.py macrolint fails when such a macro has no row, when its definition changed (digest), or
# when a row names a macro that no longer exists. name, file, line, digest, classes and facts come from the
# code database (codedb.py macrolint --write writes them, keeping each reading whose digest is unchanged).
# classes: the kinds, each followed by "(via M)" when the macro has it only through the macros M it
# expands, to any depth. facts beginning not-seen-in-this-run: a row kept by --write for a macro the run
# did not see (--prune removes it). reading is written by a person who read the macro: what it expands
# to and reaches. UNREVIEWED marks a row nobody has read yet. Tab-separated.
